_purpose: Machine-checkable transcription of the 16 BINDING LAWS in SCOPE-LEDGER.md section 4 (GHL Hybrid v3.0 run, waves w61-w66). The ledger states each law as prose that 'applies to EVERY one of the 13 units' (16 x 13 = 208 application items). Prose cannot be enforced, so every law is restated here as a named check that scripts/check-binding-laws.py actually runs. Ledger item ids are '<unit>-L<n>'; this file owns the L<n> half only.
_why_this_exists: Before this file, 14 of the 16 laws lived only in a prompt. A rule stated only in a prompt is verified by trusting a transcript, and a transcript is prose -- it can say anything. ledger-truth-gate.yml already records that exact failure for this repo: an unattended cron stamped whole units verified off prose alone. The two laws that DID have machinery (L5, L6) have it in .github/workflows/sf-prover-pin-authority.yml, and that pair is the model followed here.

_sources.sibling_precedent: .github/workflows/sf-prover-pin-authority.yml (L5, L6), scripts/check-tag-ancestry.py (ancestry idiom), .github/workflows/gate-added-paths-guard.yml (fail-closed + control job idiom)

_kinds.tree: Derivable from the repository alone: git objects, the base..head diff, commit authorship. Evaluated on every pull request. A violation fails the build.
_kinds.evidence: NOT derivable from the tree, because the law constrains what the lane DID, not what it committed (force-push, SSH, secrets in a transcript, QC by a different model). Evaluated against a per-law evidence file whose VALUES are validated -- presence alone is never enough. When no evidence directory is supplied the law is reported DEFERRED, never PASSED.

laws.text: No check deleted, skipped, xfailed or widened.
laws.covers: removed assert/pytest.raises lines, added skip/skipif/xfail markers, and thresholds moved in the permissive direction, in test paths only
every commit in base..head touching a declared pin file must be authored AND committed by a declared bot identity, and must touch nothing else

laws.text: Authority workflow mints the pin once.
laws.covers: exactly one pin-mint commit per pin file per range; a second distinct mint commit is a violation

laws.text: Collision law: open PRs and `git log --oneline -5 origin/main -- <file>` checked before each file change; no duplicate vehicle.
ONE PR per unit; a recut closes the old PR in the same run with a pointer.
If BEHIND: recut from current origin/main; never merge main into a branch.
laws.covers: git rev-list --merges on the range must be empty

laws.text: Ancestry: `git merge-base --is-ancestor <commit> origin/main` returns 0, output pasted.
laws.covers: the base ref must be an ancestor of head, i.e. the branch is on top of current origin/main and not a stale fork

laws.text: Work only in the assigned CLONE and TMPDIR.
QC by Opus-Chain (non-DeepSeek), never the builder lane.
QC returns CONFIRMED or FAILED naming each defect.

_before_state_on_origin_main._note: Direct git tree inspection of origin/main 014aad4f27a7. Only L5 and L6 have machinery; both are scoped to the Skill 49 pin file, which is the pin the authority workflow owns. Every other law is prose in a prompt and nothing in the tree reads it.
